clue.text: Some might say Hoskins is immortal on drugs

explanation.surface: A boast from the setter that he will live forever, as long as the pills keep coming.
explanation.walkthrough: Hoskins is the setter, poking fun at himself: the surface brag about living forever hides the jibe that some think him an IMMORALIST, fitting for a puzzle full of sex and drugs.
explanation.definitionFit: The setter imagines critics labelling him a person without morals, so the jibe they would aim at him is the definition.

explanation.definitionFit: This African ape, a close relative of the chimpanzee, is famous for using frequent sexual contact to settle social tension.

explanation.definitionFit: The nickname belongs to Boris Johnson, who led the Conservative Party, so it names one holder of that post.
